name: ibis budget Singapore Crystal
short_description: A 2-star budget hotel with 125 rooms in Geylang, about a 10-minute walk from Aljunied MRT, with a 4.6/5 guest rating on its own Accor listing.
ai_summary: ibis budget Singapore Crystal is located at 50 Lorong 18 Geylang, in the same Geylang neighborhood as several sister ibis budget properties, about a 10-minute walk from Aljunied MRT Station and a 10-minute drive from Orchard Road. The economy hotel offers 125 rooms across six room types (12-16 sqm), tea/coffee facilities, free WiFi and free on-site parking. Its own Accor listing shows a strong 4.6/5 guest rating from 80 reviews, and two independent sources -- a September/October 2024 Economy Class and Beyond trip report and a May 2024 YouTube room tour -- both describe small but clean, no-frills rooms that deliver reliable value for the price. The hotel does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme.

core_facts.elite_notes: This hotel does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme, per its own Accor listing; ALL member rates may still apply but no points-earning or elite benefits are offered.

research_highlights: Accor's own hotel page confirms 125 rooms across six room types, a 4.6/5 guest rating from 80 reviews, and non-participation in the ALL loyalty programme

Economy Class and Beyond's October 2024 trip report (author Kevincm) describes a reasonably spaced room, firm bed, and purified water taps instead of bottled water, calling it a bargain at the price point
An independently confirmed May 2024 YouTube room tour from creator Jovelyn Mirambel corroborates the small, clean, functional room layout
research_watchouts: The hotel does not participate in ALL - Accor Live Limitless, so no elite benefits apply despite the Accor/ibis branding
Limited desk/workspace noted in the trip report as unsuitable for extended work stays

faqs.question: Is ibis budget Singapore Crystal part of the ALL loyalty programme?
faqs.answer: No -- despite the ibis budget/Accor branding, this hotel's own Accor listing confirms it does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme, so members cannot earn or redeem points or elite benefits here, though ALL member rates may still apply.

faqs.question: What is ibis budget Singapore Crystal's guest rating?
faqs.answer: Its own Accor listing shows a 4.6/5 rating from 80 reviews, among the higher-rated budget properties in the Geylang cluster. Independent coverage, including a 2024 blog trip report and a room-tour video, both describe the rooms as small but clean and good value for the price.
